latest_news.headline: IRGC warns: will widen strikes on Israeli troops in Lebanon/Gaza if civilian death toll rises
latest_news.text: IRGC issues new threat: will expand strikes on Israeli military positions across Lebanon and Gaza if civilian casualties continue mounting. Geographic expansion of threat beyond Gulf/Israel to occupied territories.

latest_news.text: Iran continues to flatly deny any diplomatic contact with Washington. Trump claims 'very strong talks' via Witkoff channel. Iranian officials call it 'fakenews.' Gap between US claims and Iranian denial widening.

latest_news.headline: Israel kills 3 in Beirut apartment strike including 3-year-old girl — 7 overnight raids on southern suburbs
latest_news.source: Al Jazeera / CNN / Times of Israel
latest_news.text: Israeli strike on residential apartment in Bchamoun, 10km southeast of Beirut, kills 3 including a 3-year-old girl, wounds 5. No warning given. IDF also hit 7 areas in Beirut southern suburbs overnight including Bir al-Abed, Haret Hreik, Burj al-Barajneh. 1,072 killed, 2,966 injured since March 2.

latest_news.headline: IDF destroys Hezbollah fuel stations across Lebanon, targets Quds Force/IRGC positions
latest_news.text: IDF says it completed wave of strikes targeting fuel stations belonging to Al-Amana company (Hezbollah-controlled) across Lebanon, rendering them 'inoperable.' Military also claims strikes targeted IRGC Quds Force members in Beirut. Cutting Hezbollah economic infrastructure.

latest_news.headline: Trump extends Iran Hormuz deadline to March 27 — 'productive conversations' claimed, Iran denies
latest_news.text: Trump extends Iran deadline by 5 days to March 27, citing 'very good and productive conversations.' Iran foreign ministry: 'No talks held since bombing began 24 days ago.' CNN reports Iranian sources acknowledge US initiated outreach. Deadline now expires end of week.

latest_news.headline: Katz: Israel plans to expand territory under control in southern Lebanon
latest_news.text: Defense Minister Katz says Israel plans to expand territory under IDF control in southern Lebanon — ramping up ground offensive. Combined with Litani zone declaration, signals intent for broader occupation beyond current positions.
